title: asterias lutea
intro: Asterias lutea, commonly known as Sea Star, is a type of marine invertebrate animal, but I'll assume you meant to ask about Asteriscus maritimus or possibly more likely, the Asteriscus luteus plant, which is also known as the Yellow Daisy. This plant is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Asteriscus luteus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Asteriscus luteus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
